description: r71 (PLAN A7 (c) continued, B200 screen, step-capped): r63's config (A 006's recipe, keep_best_dev, cosine schedule stopped at 80 % of its length) with 128 prompts per step instead of 96, keeping the prompts seen the same: cosine over 437 steps, stopped at 350 (350 x 128 = 44,800, against r63's 467 x 96 = 44,832). Evals every 50 steps. Read paired per seed with r63's B200 kept dev (0.458 / 0.438 / 0.435 / 0.430 / 0.445). On an H200 it would need about 15,000-16,000 s of the 17,400-s budget (estimated from r63's B200 timing).
